subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should #100121 remain the combined tracker for placeholder fallout plus exec/tool no-reply recovery, or should it be split across the existing #96857 placeholder cluster and #97324 incomplete-turn/session-state work?
rationale: Current main only proves a partial placeholder fix, while the remaining behavior crosses warning-suppression and incomplete-turn policy where a narrow automated patch could undo intentional suppression boundaries.

options.title: Split to canonical work
options.body: Route the placeholder/media-text portion to #96857 and keep or link the zero-payload tool-error recovery portion under #97324 so each owner can validate its own invariant.

options.title: Keep as combined tracker
options.body: Leave #100121 open as an umbrella until both visible placeholder and no-reply recovery paths have current-main and live-channel proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow policy PR
options.body: Approve a targeted PR only for dynamic suppression/no-payload fallback semantics after documenting the compatibility boundary for static tool-error suppression.

recommendation.title: Split to canonical work
recommendation.body: Route the placeholder/media-text portion to #96857 and keep or link the zero-payload tool-error recovery portion under #97324 so each owner can validate its own invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged partial provider fallback repair that most directly overlaps the visible placeholder half of the issue; the remaining split can then route to incomplete-turn owners.
